result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual and history-heavy, with sparse aspirational wording. Values are brief and in headings or short lists, not developed. The page uses first-person plural in its mission and section lines. Employees and inclusion get the most attention. Commitments are hedged or stated as belief, and most content is product, history, and partner promotion.
